source_row.rationale: School-based scoliosis screening is intended to identify adolescents with physical exam findings suggestive of possible spinal curvature (such as asymmetry noted on a forward bend test), prompting referral for further evaluation by a healthcare provider (which may include imaging) to confirm the diagnosis and determine if treatment or monitoring is needed — the screening itself does not provide a definitive diagnosis.
